title: Console: a full-page record form opened on the app-name address saves, then leaves the document (#27454 holds only on the package-id address)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ① a measured defect. The card thread for #27555 measured it on the live stack while pinning #27454 (report 6519817337, `out_of_scope_findings`; table in PR #28034's Acceptance notes).
Reach: any user who opens a record's full-page form by its app-name address (`/apps/<app name>/<object>/record/<id>/edit` or `/apps/<app name>/<object>/new`). That covers old bookmarks, shared links and every live spec's address. The save succeeds, but the page leaves the app and the toast is lost, as in #27454.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (console).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "record form goBack direct URL app name alias save leaves app canonical pathname replace location.key" → #27454 (closed, the package-id case this extends), #25458 and #9468 (closed, other routes).

## Observed
Measured on PR #28034's stack (one fresh page per row):

| Address | Mode | `history.state.key` after load | URL after Save | Toasts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `showcase_app` (name alias) | edit | generated | `about:blank` | 0 |
| `showcase_app` (name alias) | new | generated | `about:blank` | 0 |
| `com.example.showcase` (package id) | edit | none | record detail, in app | 1 |
| `com.example.showcase` (package id) | new | none | object list, in app | 1 |

In a real tab, the alias rows land on whatever page the tab showed before.

## Mechanism
`AppContent`'s `canonicalAppPathname` effect (#26183) moves an alias URL to the package-id address with `navigate(…, { replace: true })`. That gives the entry a generated `location.key`. `RecordFormPage`'s `hasInAppHistory` reads `location.key !== 'default'`, so it reads true, and `goBack` runs `navigate(-1)` out of the document.

## Wanted
Opened by direct URL on either address, Save stays in the app: edit lands on the record, new lands on the list, each with one toast. The likely fix is in `RecordFormPage`'s in-app-history test, not the redirect: for example, mark entries the console itself pushed, rather than trusting any non-default key. ⛔ `console/AppContent.tsx` is in seat 4's open PR #27907, so leave the redirect alone while that PR is open. Pin it with an alias-address case in `ui/e2e/live/record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` (added by PR #28034), plus a jsdom test beside `RecordFormPage`.

Dedupe words: RecordFormPage goBack location.key, canonical app pathname replace history, direct URL alias save leaves app.

Related: #27454, #27555, PR #28034, #26183.
